description: Cluster Chart - Custom Power BI Visual This Cluster Chart is a custom Power BI visual that provides a flexible and interactive way to visualize clustered data. It allows users to compare multiple measures across different categories while offering features such as dropdown filters, data labels, and customizable table views. Key Features: Interactive Dropdowns Users can select different categories (X-axis) and measures (Y-axis) using dropdown filters. The measure dropdown provides an option to view all measures or filter by specific roles. Dynamic Clustered Bar Chart Displays data using a bar chart, where each category is represented on the X-axis, and the selected measures define the bars. Uses D3.js and Chart.js for rendering, ensuring smooth interactivity. Data labels are shown on bars to display percentage values clearly. Tabular Data Representation A table below the chart shows the same data in tabular format. It includes color-coded labels to match the chart for better readability. Customizable Appearance The chart and table can be dynamically updated based on the selected options. Users can toggle the visibility of the X-axis and Y-axis through formatting settings. License Validation The visual includes an authentication system to check for valid license keys. If the license is valid and active, full functionality is enabled; otherwise, certain features are restricted.…
